messages.subject: Re: Milkweed products - Fall Launch 2026
messages.text:
I had purchased some milkweed seeds from you last year but they never came up this spring. We had a lousy spring so maybe that was the problem. I have never seen Monarch butterflies here in Calgary so I don't know if they come this far north and west. It is too bad as I would loved to have them in my garden/
 

 Carol Lylyk
